summary: Legs B day, so extra carbs around dinner. No wellness-bar protein smoothie or Evolve shake on today's menu, so pre-workout and breakfast lean on turkey, eggs, oats and fruit instead; lunch and dinner bring in two new chicken preparations (pizza-style roasted chicken, soy sauce chicken) not used in the last few days.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Eggs, turkey and oats for protein, bread and fruit for carbs and fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Nolita roasted chicken pizza as the main (new this week) with extra chicken breast, rice and sweet potato for leg-day carbs.

items.name: Pizza Roasted Chicken, Roasted Peppers, Reggiano Ricotta Spinach Sauce

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs plus lean turkey protein and berries; no protein smoothie on the menu today.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Soy sauce chicken (new main) carries protein and carbs for a leg day, extra chicken breast, rice and black beans close out the day.

items.name: Mary's Free Range Soy Sauce Chicken
